notes: Explore idea: isolation forest (Liu, Ting & Zhou 2008/2012) as the ninth research-algorithms tool, from the research-tools candidate list. Because the algorithm is random, verification compares 20,000-tree expected scores with scikit-learn 1.9.1 on three UCI datasets (wholesale, ionosphere, breast cancer Wisconsin): max abs diff 0.0025-0.0034, mean ~0.0006, which equals the engine's own seed-to-seed gap (0.0029), with a signed-bias bound in the test. Default-100-tree AUC over seeds matches (0.855 / 0.985). Finding: on the long-tailed wholesale spend, raw-scale top ten are all big spenders; on log scale 8/10 are near-zero buyers in some group. Per-row score SD across seeds at 100 trees: median 0.008, worst 0.024. Venture tests 41/41; Playwright 1200/390 px clean. Next: extended isolation forest mode.

certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured
